metadata.task: Nigerian Pidgin-English code-switched artisan dispatch commands (Lagos informal markets)
metadata.notes: Source of truth for the ground truth dataset. Samples 01-05 were recorded with natural ad-libbing rather than verbatim script reading; transcripts were aligned to the actual speech post-hoc. The Colab notebook (AreaHustle_Benchmark_Colab.ipynb) embeds the same data; if you edit here, mirror the change in the notebook's DATASET cell.

samples.transcript: I dey Ikeja underbridge, my brake dey sound, I need mechanic for 5k.
My kitchen pipe don burst, I need plumber fast fast, I get 5k for hand.
I need rewinder wey go check my pumping machine, my budget na 6k.
Electrician dey around Surulere? Light dey full house but my breaker dey trip, I get like 5k for hand.
Who dey do carpentry around Ikorodu garage? My kitchen wardrobe don fall, I get like 5000 naira to give.
My generator alternator don burn for Festac first gate, I need rewinder urgently for 8k.
Vulcanizer abeg, my tyre puncture for Maryland roundabout, quick assistance for 2000 naira.
I dey Lekki phase 1, AC dey blow hot air, mechanic or AC repairer abeg for 10000 naira.
Make painter come paint one room for Ogba, paint dey ground already, labor na 5k.
Panel beater needed for Oshodi bus stop, moto scratch side, I fit pay 12k.
Welder dey this area? Iron gate hinge don cut for Ojuelegba, 4500 naira dey.
Plumber abeg come fix my WC sink for Ilupeju, water dey leak everywhere, I get 5000.
Generator rewinder needed for Victoria Island, starter coil don bad, 15k available.
My ceiling fan motor dey make heavy noise for Mushin, electrician abeg, 3500.
I need bricklayer to patch small soakaway crack for Agege, I go pay 6000 naira.
Car no wan start for Gbagada expressway, mechanic come with jumper wire, 4k dey.
Carpenter needed to fix four office chairs for Marina Lagos island, budget na 8000.
Roofer abeg come check my leaking zinc roof for Ketu, rain dey enter parlour, I get 9000.
Make tailor come sew five school uniform for Egbeda, material don buy already, na 7000 I go pay.
Fridge repairer needed for Berger, my freezer no dey freeze again, 11000 dey ground.
